hot.title: From AGI to ASI
hot.summary: Researchers at Google DeepMind establish an analytical framework to map the potential evolution of artificial intelligence from AGI to ASI, outlining four technological pathways and six specific bottlenecks. The work provides a research agenda for predicting and managing the development of advanced AI capabilities.

hot.title: MiniMax Sparse Attention
hot.summary: MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA) offers an efficient, blockwise sparse attention mechanism for large language models, significantly reducing computational cost for ultra-long contexts. It maintains model performance across diverse tasks while achieving notable speedups, such as a 14.2x prefill and 7.6x decoding speedup at 1M context on H800 GPUs, driven by a 28.4x reduction in attention FLOPs.

hot.title: EvoArena: Tracking Memory Evolution for Robust LLM Agents in Dynamic Environments
hot.summary: This research introduces EvoArena, a benchmark suite designed to evaluate Large Language Model (LLM) agents in continually evolving environments, alongside EvoMem, a patch-based memory paradigm that explicitly tracks memory evolution. EvoMem consistently enhances agent robustness in dynamic settings, yielding improvements of up to 6.1% in chain-level accuracy on the new benchmark and significantly reducing regressions in software engineering tasks.

hot.title: World Tracing: Generative Pixel-Aligned Geometry Beyond the Visible
hot.summary: World Tracing, developed by World Labs and the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, presents a generative pixel-aligned multilayer 3D geometry representation. It reconstructs visible surfaces and completes occluded 3D geometry from 2D inputs, showing improved accuracy on visible surfaces and comprehensive geometry generation for objects, scenes, and dynamic content while supporting various downstream 3D applications.

hot.title: Can I Buy Your KV Cache?
hot.summary: Researchers from Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen, introduced a "prefill CDN" model, demonstrating that reusing precomputed Key-Value caches for shared document prefixes in Large Language Models is token-exact. This approach achieved 9-50x compute cost savings for repeated document access, offering substantial efficiency gains for long-context applications.

hot.title: Dense Supervision, Sparse Updates: On the Sparsity and Geometry of On-Policy Distillation
hot.summary: Researchers from Nanjing University and Alibaba Group investigated the parameter updates of On-Policy Distillation (OPD), revealing that it induces small, sparse, and spectrally concentrated modifications to model weights, primarily affecting off-principal directions. These findings indicate that OPD's on-policy data distribution drives a localized "editing" style of parameter refinement, distinct from dense supervised approaches.

hot.title: First Steps Toward Automated AI Research
RepWAM: World Action Modeling with Representation Visual-Action Tokenizers
hot.summary: RepWAM introduces a representation-centric World Action Model that employs a novel visual-action tokenizer (RepViTok) to create a semantically aligned latent space for robot control. This model improves visual dynamics and action prediction, demonstrating enhanced performance in real-world manipulation tasks, achieving up to 80% success on tasks like "Push the drawer" and 89.3% average success on RoboTwin 2.0 Easy tasks.

hot.title: EurekAgent: Agent Environment Engineering is All You Need For Autonomous Scientific Discovery
hot.summary: EUREKAGENT introduces an agent environment engineering paradigm that coordinates off-the-shelf LLM-based CLI agents for autonomous scientific discovery, emphasizing external environmental design over prescriptive workflows. The system achieved new state-of-the-art results across mathematics, kernel engineering, and machine learning tasks through structured permissions, artifacts, budgets, and human-in-the-loop interfaces.

hot.title: Breaking Entropy Bounds: Accelerating RL Training via MTP with Rejection Sampling
hot.summary: Bebop, developed by Alibaba's Qwen Team, accelerates large language model reinforcement learning training by enhancing Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) efficiency. It addresses MTP acceptance rate degradation by identifying target model entropy as the dominant factor and introduces an end-to-end Total Variation loss and a pre-RL adaptation strategy, achieving up to 1.8x end-to-end training acceleration.

hot.title: MaxProof: Scaling Mathematical Proof with Generative-Verifier RL and Population-Level Test-Time Scaling
hot.summary: MiniMax developed MaxProof, a framework that significantly improves large language models' capabilities in generating competition-level mathematical proofs. This is achieved by integrating a multi-stage trained M3 model, which can generate, verify, and refine proofs, with a population-level test-time scaling method that iteratively evolves and selects solutions. MaxProof enabled the M3 model to surpass human gold-medal thresholds on IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026, boosting its one-shot scores by 8 and 10 points, respectively.

hot.title: InterleaveThinker: Reinforcing Agentic Interleaved Generation
hot.summary: InterleaveThinker introduces a multi-agent framework that equips fixed image generators with robust interleaved text and image generation capabilities. It addresses challenges like visual over-reliance and step-wise error accumulation through a Planner, Critic, and iterative refinement, achieving performance comparable to proprietary models on the UEval benchmark with an average score of 66.3 and significantly improving base models' reasoning abilities on WISE and RISE benchmarks.

hot.title: SpatialClaw: Rethinking Action Interface for Agentic Spatial Reasoning
hot.summary: SpatialClaw is a training-free framework for agentic spatial reasoning that enhances vision-language models by treating code as an iterative orchestration space for perception tools and scientific libraries. It enables dynamic sequencing and composition of tools, resulting in improved performance on a wide array of 3D and 4D spatial reasoning benchmarks.

hot.title: RepFusion: Leveraging Multimodal Priors for Denoising in Representation Space
hot.summary: RepFusion introduces a text-to-image (T2I) generation framework that leverages a frozen, pretrained Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to actively denoise in representation space by dynamically processing evolving noisy visual representations. This method enhances T2I performance and achieves parameter efficiency by utilizing the MLLM's strong multimodal priors for adaptive conditioning.

hot.title: Self-Harness: Harnesses That Improve Themselves
hot.summary: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory researchers developed Self-Harness, a paradigm allowing a fixed Large Language Model (LLM) agent to autonomously improve its own operating harness by iteratively diagnosing weaknesses, proposing minimal modifications, and validating them. This method achieved significant performance improvements on the Terminal-Bench-2.0 benchmark across various LLMs, demonstrating the generation of targeted, model-specific harness configurations.

hot.title: Agents-K1: Towards Agent-native Knowledge Orchestration
hot.summary: Agents-K1 introduces a unified pipeline to construct agent-native scientific knowledge graphs from raw documents at scale, creating Scholar-KG from 2.46 million papers. The system enhanced multi-hop scientific reasoning for LLMs, with GPT-5.2's rationale accuracy increasing from 41.8% to 66.3% on geoscience research questions, and employs a 4B-parameter extraction model performing comparably to larger LLMs.

hot.title: Surflo: Consistent 3D Surface Flow Model with Global State
hot.summary: Surflo reconstructs consistent 3D surfaces from multi-view images by employing a global scene latent representation and a flow-matching decoder that enables arbitrary-resolution point cloud generation. The model achieves higher quality and efficiency than prior feed-forward methods and outperforms optimization-based techniques in sparse-view scenarios, yielding detailed meshes from a variable number of input images.

hot.title: Test-Time Gradient Guidance of Flow Policies in Reinforcement Learning
hot.summary: Researchers from UC Berkeley and Physical Intelligence introduce QGF (Q-Guided Flow), a reinforcement learning algorithm that achieves policy optimization entirely at test time. This method guides a pre-trained flow policy using gradients from a learned Q-function, demonstrating performance competitive with or superior to state-of-the-art training-time RL methods on continuous control tasks, while improving computational efficiency compared to Best-of-N sampling.

hot.title: RLCSD: Reinforcement Learning with Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation
hot.summary: RLCSD (Reinforcement Learning with Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation) enhances the training of large reasoning models by mitigating "privilege-induced style drift" in on-policy self-distillation. The method achieves this by generating a contrastive, task-focused token-level learning signal that is robustly integrated with outcome-level rewards, leading to improved performance and stability on various reasoning tasks.

hot.title: μ0μ_0μ0​: A Scalable 3D Interaction-Trace World Model
hot.summary: μ0, a 3D interaction-trace world model, and the TraceExtract data pipeline enable robots to learn from uncurated video data by predicting compact 3D trajectories of salient interaction points. The framework demonstrates competitive performance on simulated and real-world robot manipulation tasks, sometimes outperforming baselines that require extensive action-labeled data.

likes.title: Latent Spatial Memory for Video World Models
likes.summary: Mirage introduces a video world model that uses a latent spatial memory to generate 3D-consistent videos, achieving up to 10.57 times faster end-to-end generation and 55 times lower GPU memory usage compared to prior RGB-based memory approaches while enhancing geometric coherence.

likes.title: ICA Lens: Interpreting Language Models Without Training Another Dictionary
likes.summary: Researchers Sida Liu and Feijiang Han introduced ICALens, a workflow that makes Independent Component Analysis practical and efficient for interpreting large language model activations. The method recovers human-interpretable features with high non-Gaussianity and demonstrates competitive utility in sparse probing and targeted probe perturbation tasks compared to existing methods like PCA and some sparse autoencoder variants.

likes.title: Kwai Keye-VL-2.0 Technical Report
likes.summary: Kuaishou Group's Keye Team developed Kwai Keye-VL-2.0, an open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) multimodal foundation model designed for understanding ultra-long video contexts and enhancing agentic intelligence. The model addresses extreme context scaling and catastrophic forgetting through sparse attention and multi-teacher distillation, achieving leading performance in temporal localization and strong results in various agent tasks.

likes.title: Toward Generalist Autonomous Research via Hypothesis-Tree Refinement
likes.summary: An AI framework named Arbor enables autonomous research by organizing hypotheses, experimental evidence, and insights into a persistent tree structure. This approach allows agents to manage long-horizon scientific tasks and iteratively improve research artifacts more effectively than existing methods.

likes.title: End-to-End Context Compression at Scale
likes.summary: Latent Context Language Models (LCLMs) offer an encoder-decoder framework for compressing large language model input contexts, enabling efficient handling of millions of tokens. This approach achieved up to an 8.8x faster Time To First Token and substantially reduced peak GPU memory compared to KV cache methods, while preserving high accuracy across diverse long-context tasks.

likes.title: Next Forcing: Causal World Modeling with Multi-Chunk Prediction
likes.summary: Next Forcing introduces a multi-chunk prediction framework to enhance causal world models by providing denser temporal supervision, addressing the issue of myopic supervision. It achieves new state-of-the-art performance on robot manipulation tasks, accelerates training by up to 2.3x, and enables 2x inference speedup while improving physical dynamics understanding and general video generation quality.

likes.title: DiffusionGemma: 4x faster text generation
Echo-Memory: A Controlled Study of Memory in Action World Models
likes.summary: A controlled study by researchers from various institutions systematically compared different memory mechanisms in action world models, demonstrating that traditional replay metrics are insufficient for assessing a model's capacity to preserve consistent scene and object identity across camera revisits. The study revealed distinct performance trade-offs among memory families using a new three-branch evaluation protocol.

likes.title: AHA-WAM:Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Modeling with Observation-Guided Context Routing
likes.summary: AHA-WAM introduces an asynchronous, horizon-adaptive architecture for robot manipulation, decoupling the temporal scales of visual world planning and action execution. This approach achieves a 4.59x inference speedup and a 24.17 Hz control frequency (up to 56.95 Hz with distillation), while maintaining a 92.80% success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 tasks and 78.33% on real-world tasks.

likes.title: MotionWAM: Towards Foundation World Action Models for Real-Time Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
likes.summary: A real-time World Action Model, MotionWAM, is introduced for humanoid robots, unifying whole-body control into a single motion latent space for complex loco-manipulation tasks. This approach achieved an overall success rate of 76.1% across nine real-world tasks, outperforming existing baselines by over 32% absolute gain and maintaining a closed-loop operating frequency of 4.9 Hz.

likes.title: OMG: Omni-Modal Motion Generation for Generalist Humanoid Control
likes.summary: Researchers at Tsinghua University developed OMG, an omni-modal motion generation framework, to enable generalist humanoid control by interpreting diverse human intents. The system leverages a large-scale, curated multi-modal motion corpus and a diffusion-based Motion Transformer, achieving real-time execution of complex, compositional commands on a physical Unitree G1 robot with high fidelity and stability.

likes.title: Rethinking the Divergence Regularization in LLM RL
likes.summary: DRPO introduces a novel regularization scheme for large language model reinforcement learning, integrating a divergence-based trust region with smooth quadratic regularization. This approach stabilizes training and improves efficiency, matching or surpassing existing ratio-based and hard-mask methods across diverse LLM architectures and precision environments.
